QuestInfo.name: A Strange Tale
QuestInfo.0: The old man you saved turned out to be none other than the Faceless Monster who had been seen around the town. He grabs hold of you, telling you he needs your help.
QuestInfo.1: You decided to hear what the Faceless Monster has to ask of you. Sit a while and listen to his story.
QuestInfo.2: There's no particular reason you have to get yourself involved in all of this, but something deep down in your heart is nagging you to make the right choice instead of the rational, self-serving choice.
